describe: a level-crossing warning signal seen from straight above, top-down only: the round top of its grey post in the middle, and across it, running top to bottom, the top edge of a black backboard carrying two round lamp hoods side by side, one near the top and one near the bottom, each hood a black half-ring open toward the right with dark unlit red glass inside, a thin white and red St Andrew's cross plate edge on top
